title: New 1E,1′E-hydrazine-bis(phenoxy-1,2,3-triazol-acetamide) derivatives as potent inhibitors against acetylcholinesterase, butyrylcholinesterase, and α-glucosidase
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29960-29971
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03877D, Paper
Open Access

Shahab Kermaninia, Maryam Mohammadi-Khanaposhtani, Halil Şenol, Fatemeh Sadat Khajeh Mohammadilar, Navid Dastyafteh, Fatemeh Moradkhani, Saeedeh Saeedi, Bagher Larijani, Armin Dadgar, Aydın Aktaş, Nastaran Sadeghian, Parham Taslimi, Mohammad Mahdavi
In this study, novel 1E,1′E-hydrazine-bis(phenoxy-1,2,3-triazol-acetamide) derivatives 10a–n were synthesized, and because of their structural features, they were evaluated against acetylcholinesterase, butyrylcholinesterase, and α-glucosidase.
